title: Houston finds crystal dice hidden for a son-in-law

tellings.quote: like came home from school and found those cuz he could like hear them or feel them energy

plain: A boy named Houston in Atlanta, Georgia, is said to have come home from school and found crystal dice that had been hidden away as a gift for a son-in-law, because he could hear or feel their energy. Ky Dickens, who made a documentary about nonspeaking children said to read minds, tells it from what the family, through a woman named Katie, told her. If true, it would mean the boy sensed objects he had no ordinary way to know about.
